MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing and solder seal connectors fit my small electronics work because they help insulate wiring and make permanent connections after prototyping.",
    "The digital caliper feels useful for checking board dimensions and mounting clearances, giving it a concrete role alongside my components and hardware."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heavy battery lugs are electrical parts, but their cable size does not fit the small battery holders and Arduino components I have used.",
    "The filament and thick acrylic assume fabrication needs I have not established; working with circuit boards does not mean I currently need printing supplies or enclosure material.",
    "Another caster set repeats a recent purchase without an evident separate project, while the feeler gauge measures mechanical gaps I do not currently need to check."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into a general interest in any workshop or fabrication supply.",
    "My caster purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to buy more casters, even though that need may already be met."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The small scale of my breadboards, battery holder, relay, and wiring accessories matters when choosing compatible electrical supplies.",
    "I need a specific use for an item now: wiring insulation has a clear purpose for my projects, while printer filament requires an unsupported assumption that I have a printer and something to print."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my small electronics work but extended it too broadly into fabrication supplies and repeat hardware purchases."
}
